en: Black‑and‑white image showing a large, steep‑roofed building with dormer windows and a tiled roof, set in a forested mountain valley. Conifer trees line a curving driveway in the foreground, and a rocky, cliff-like hillside rises behind dense mixed forest in the background. The composition resembles a rural inn or institutional building in an alpine or central European landscape.
